best_idea: One fixed 8 ms timer turn with catch-up, plus a dirty-flag queue drained only up to the count seen on entry, so each tick has bounded state-sync work and timers fire on server time even after a stall.
decision_why: Keep the fixed step with catch-up and the bounded drain; do not port the three-ring 4096-slot wheel, since a flat timer list is enough for a fight engine until timer counts are measured.
acceptance: Server test: with the loop stalled for 50 ms, a 100 ms timer scheduled at t=0 fires on the first 8 ms turn at or after 100 ms (104 ms), and a dirty drain given three entities marked during its own pass leaves exactly those three for the next pass.
